images.caption: Figure 1:PaperTrajectoryoverview.We collect arXiv version histories for papers accepted at five AI conferences in 2026. We select paper versions with a time gap of more than 30 days and pair consecutive selected versions. GPT-6 Astra characterizes each pair across 14 revision dimensions and judges the overall quality change. Five graduate-level researchers validate change descriptions and assess overall quality changes on sampled pairs. AI reviewers assess anonymized manuscript versions independently, returning overall assessments, strengths, and weaknesses.
